page.overview:
Who is Candy Person 67?

Despite being a chocolate rabbit, his ears are melted to the front of his head making him resemble a duck. Because he is melted. he is physically deformed, giving him a bent arm and an unusually thick leg. As a Zombie his "ears" are replaced with, what resembles, an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oreo Oreo].
